# Nguồn

Chép từ https://github.com/gauravhq/JLPTSuccess, commit `c333cded81852d5e52a7a3449c59fa09212e25d4` (18/11/2026).

- `kanji.json` ← `N5/data/kanji.json`, chỉ giữ các trường Kotoba dùng: glyph, lesson_order, on, kun, radical_decomposition, stroke_count, examples (form, reading, gloss), lookalikes
- `LICENSE` ← `LICENSE` (MIT)
- `NOTICES.md` ← `N5/NOTICES.md` (ghi công KanjiVG, VOICEVOX)
- SVG thứ tự nét → `public/kanji/svg/` (CC BY-SA 3.0, KanjiVG)
- Audio cách đọc kanji → `public/audio/kanji/` (VOICEVOX:春日部つむぎ)
